name: Ruinarch+
author: Xm0x
description: Bug fixes, rotting corpses, a Mass Grave village building, a plague curfew with closed borders, factions that only attack what they know about, news that travels on foot and by gossip, villages that search for their missing, migration that follows a village's fortunes, villages that grow into Towns and Cities, famine and unrest, hunters and traders. Each change is checked against the decompiled game source.
